## Abliterated Large V2 API

Abliterated Large V2 is a large language model by Abliteration AI, available on the Venice API as `abliteration-abliterated-model-large-v2`. Requests are anonymized, so the provider never sees your identity.

Abliterated Large V2 is Abliteration AI's unrestricted reasoning model, based on GLM-5.3 and further abliterated and fine-tuned. Text-only with 1M context, for harder reasoning and evaluation workloads. Always reasons; depth can be set to low, high, or max.

### Abliterated Large V2 API pricing

| Model ID | Variant | Privacy | Price |
|---|---|---|---|
| `abliteration-abliterated-model-large-v2` | Standard | Anonymized | $3.00 / $5.00 per 1M |

### Abliterated Large V2 specifications

| Spec | Value |
|---|---|
| Provider | Abliteration AI |
| Released | Oct 1, 2026 |
| Privacy | Anonymized |
| Status | Stable |
| Context window | 1M tokens |
| Max output | 32K tokens |
| Reasoning effort | Not adjustable |

### How to use the Abliterated Large V2 API

Send requests to `POST https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/chat/completions` with `"model": "abliteration-abliterated-model-large-v2"` and your API key.

```bash
curl https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/chat/completions \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $VENICE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "model": "abliteration-abliterated-model-large-v2",
    "messages": [{ "role": "user", "content": "Explain TEE attestation in two sentences." }]
  }'
```
